lines.text: Your colony guard has seen something you never noticed in three years.
Every morning, Ramesh salutes the same four neighbours. Separately.
Eight oh one, Rohan. Salute.
Eight oh two, Priya. Salute.
Eight oh three, Arjun. Salute.
Eight forty, Sharma ji. The arm just stays up now.
Three years. Same four cars. Same four salutes.
Then one day, his arm just quits.
So Ramesh finally reads their parking stickers.
All four cars. Same tech park.
Same building.
So he walks up to them, bro, just go together.
So they made a carpool group.
Forty seven messages later, nobody knew who was driving, and Sharma ji was still two minutes away.
Group, dead. Four cars. Four salutes.
Turns out, the hard part of carpooling isn't the driving.
It's the deciding.
So they let an app do the deciding.
A roster picks who drives today. One tap says you're ready. And everyone watches the car arrive. Live.
Now it's one car, four friends, and one salute.
Ramesh's arm has never been happier.
Sharma ji is still late though. But now, everyone can see exactly where.
If your colony guard deserves a break, the app's called Sahyatri.
Check it out. Link in bio.
